wholePhysicalScope: Two contiguous native roof traces in the named temple compound control the main sanctum and hall. Their arrangement matches the photographed series of roofs at the north edge of the southern courtyard.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the composite slate roof, stone shrine, carved timber hall and paved court.
limitations: The two native roof rectangles and precinct locate the standing temple. The short west vestibule, minor shrines and immediate courtyard paths are placed from site photographs and are approximate.
Exact section heights, structural timber joints, iconography and ornament spacing are estimated. The model represents the standing public exterior and small shrines in the immediate court.

The photographs establish the current roof profiles, masonry and timber character. The original Qualla file appeared to depict a reproduction of a lion door fitting, with insufficient source clarity to use as architectural reference.
